name: roots
title: Root System Analysis
subtitle: Semi-automatic root tracing with SmartRoot
description: Quantifies root system architecture: total length, lateral branch density, depth, lateral spread. Detects roots via ridge enhancement → Otsu threshold → skeletonization. Outputs RSML (topology + geometry), CSV measurements, and ROI.
method: Ridge-enhanced Otsu threshold + skeletonize. For detailed tracing, uses SmartRoot SR_Explorer interactive canvas. Fallback: automatic paths from skeleton.
dataType: root images (bright root on dark background, RGB or grayscale)

outputs.name: TotalLength
outputs.label: Total root length
outputs.description: Sum of all skeleton path lengths

outputs.name: LateralCount
outputs.label: Lateral root count
outputs.description: Number of second-order and higher branches

outputs.name: MaxDepth
outputs.label: Maximum root depth
outputs.description: Distance from root crown to deepest point

outputs.name: LateralSpread
outputs.label: Lateral spread (width)
outputs.description: Bounding box width perpendicular to depth axis

outputs.name: ConvexHullArea
outputs.label: Convex hull area
outputs.description: Area of convex hull around root system

outputs.name: DensityPerMm
outputs.label: Root length density
outputs.description: Total root length per unit convex hull area

parameters.name: ridgeRadius
parameters.label: Ridge detection radius
parameters.description: Sigma for ridge/vessel filter. Larger = thicker roots.

parameters.name: skeletonMinLength
parameters.label: Skeleton minimum branch length
parameters.description: Prune skeleton branches shorter than this. Eliminates noise.

parameters.name: useSmartRoot
parameters.label: Use SmartRoot interactive tracing
parameters.description: If true, launches SR_Explorer for manual/semi-automatic tracing. Otherwise runs fully automatic detection.

publications: Lobet et al. (2011). Root System Markup Language (RSML): A Unified Root Architecture Data Format. Plant Physiology.
